items.summary: Handoff: preserve the current queue boundary. Continue source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, bounded read-only evidence work, and failure repair-or-close review. Do not create production work, requeue failures, add telemetry or dependencies, change configuration, spend, or adopt GitHub components until lineage, validation, security, and owner gates are complete.

Approve containment-only execution. Continue existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, bounded read-only legal/security evidence work, and failed-work repair-or-close review. No new queue work is technically eligible: the authoritative candidate list is empty, existing capacity is occupied, and current instrumentation must be used without additions or duplicate requests. Do not create production changes, requeue failures, add dependencies, change configuration, spend, expand monetization, or adopt external components. Failed work remains isolated until lineage, ownership, root cause, focused validation, rollback, deduplication, and explicit requeue-or-close evidence are documented. Preserve unknown revenue, ROI, margin, causal lift, cost-to-learn, and operational outcomes.

Continue existing measurement and attribution reconciliation using available telemetry only. Do not assign aggregate provider commission to any site, invent telemetry, or claim financial or causal outcomes. Keep deployed improvements in their existing measurement windows and record results only when source evidence is available.

Keep SearchWoot private. Continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. External outreach, public exposure, alert expansion, configuration changes, deployment, dependencies, and spend remain blocked pending human-counsel review, owner authorization, and completion of legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates.

Retain product, CRO, and site opportunities as deferred handoffs only. The proposed queue-lineage, measurement-state, control-plane, and component opportunities are feasible in principle but require available capacity, isolated implementation, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, and owner or security gates before entering the queue. No proposal, experiment, prototype, GitHub adoption, or change request is justified this cycle.

Continue existing bounded security evidence capture only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications. Missing authentication, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, TLS, and disclosure evidence remains unknown and does not authorize security-sensitive release or public exposure.
